name: harvey-fort-bend-tx
description: Real UAS (drone) photos of one flooded residential subdivision after Hurricane Harvey, from the FloodNet dataset. Frames 7300-7612 of one numbered image sequence, all over the same subdivision.
attribution: Drone imagery: FloodNet (Rahnemoonfar et al., 2021, BinaLab/UMBC), Hurricane Harvey 2017, CDLA-Permissive-1.0

images.name: floodnet-7300
images.title: FloodNet-Supervised v1.0, test/test-org-img/7300.jpg
images.credit: FloodNet dataset (Rahnemoonfar et al., 2021), Bina Lab, University of Maryland, Baltimore County
images.capture_date: 2017-09 (after Hurricane Harvey; the one original we checked, 7320.jpg, has EXIF DateTimeOriginal 2017:09:04 16:01:50)
images.location: Greater Houston, Texas (FloodNet reports Fort Bend County and nearby areas; GPS is stripped from the files, so the exact subdivision is unknown)
images.sensor: NIKON 1 S2 (EXIF of 7320.jpg), nadir view from a small UAS
images.author: Maryam Rahnemoonfar et al. (Bina Lab, UMBC), FloodNet
